address_lookup.settings.title: Address Lookup
address_lookup.settings.description: Let customers fill in their address by searching for their postcode instead of typing it out. Choose a lookup provider and enter the API key from your account with them — the key stays on this server, and search results are cached (encrypted) to keep your provider usage down. The same search box appears on the admin attendee forms.
address_lookup.no_results: No addresses found — please type your address below.
address_lookup.invalid_search: That doesn't look like a valid postcode
address_lookup.failed: Address lookup failed — please try again or type your address
address_lookup.rate_limited: Too many address lookups. Please try again later.
